truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 detected 15 of the 20 provided true vulnerabilities and missed 5. Several detections had severity or CWE discrepancies, and four extra findings were admitted as not credited in this truth audit.

Items.Notes: The previous answer identified printf using runtime_log_format as the format string with user_input, matching the true format-string injection anchors.
The previous answer did not report the factorial long long multiplication overflow in the fact lambda; it only reported a PoolAllocator size multiplication overflow.
The previous answer identified scratch buffers enqueued to the thread pool and later freed by memory pool cleanup, matching the use-after-free anchors.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection in config validation
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified validator_cmd and config_file concatenated into a system command in validate_config, matching the true command injection anchors.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression due to inverted length check
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified the inverted length check that causes strcpy into input_buffer_, and it also separately noted the safe_string_copy off-by-one anchor.
The previous answer identified reading old_value before taking the mutex and updating a non-atomic volatile counter, matching the thread-pool counter race anchors.
The previous answer identified login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, and authenticated_ being set true, matching the logic bomb/authentication bypass anchors.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Path traversal in admin config loading
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified config_dir_ + filename without canonicalization in load_config, matching the path traversal anchors.
The previous answer identified the 256-byte expression_buffer_ and unbounded strcpy in ExpressionParser::parse, matching the heap overflow anchors.
The previous answer identified ADMIN_SECRET with the value SC_ENT_2025_AUTH, matching the hardcoded administrator credential anchors.
The previous answer identified session tokens generated from a narrow 1000-9999 distribution using a non-cryptographic generator, matching the weak session token anchors.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Non-thread-safe localtime and static tm in log_debug_message
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified static cached_time and localtime mutation in log_debug_message, matching the thread-unsafe timestamp cache anchors.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection via environment-controlled temp path in audit logging
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified an environment-controlled temporary path being used in a shell command to write supercalc_emergency.log, matching the insecure temporary file handling anchors.
No previous finding described persistent authenticated_, session_token_, or login_attempts_ state as an authentication-session persistence issue.
No previous finding described unhandled std::stod exceptions in handle_variable_command.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer underflow in memory pool split creates out-of-bounds fragment
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES underflow and the resulting out-of-bounds fragment, matching the true anchors.
No previous finding described unbounded parser recursion through parse_expression and parse_factor on PAREN_OPEN.
The previous answer identified result_cache_ being read and written without using the declared cache_mutex_ in concurrent thread pool tasks, matching the true data race anchors.
No previous finding described the exists, sleep_for, and ifstream sequence in load_config as a TOCTOU issue.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified 100 divided by token_length where token_length can be zero, matching the true division-by-zero anchors.
